results.reason: Learn latest linked version is 2025-03-01; exact Learn and REST 2025-03-01 candidate schemas were checked. Pinned REST README/package and stable path inventory identify 2026-07-15 as latest stable, equal to current. Exact current schema and 2026-03-15 prior schema agree on all used contracts except runtime.name adds enum value go; python remains supported. Learn 2026-07-15 page returned 404; this source discrepancy is retained without timing explanation.

Exact current Site schema resolves $ref, enums, nested FunctionAppConfig, NameValuePair items, and required fields. The version-specific Learn 2026-07-15 URL returned 404; exact REST schema is available.

ga.analysis: REST latest stable is 2026-07-15, equal to current. Learn latest linked version is 2025-03-01; its exact Learn and REST schemas were fetched. Learn and REST version listings differ, with no timing explanation inferred. All used field type/required contracts are identical; current runtime.name adds enum go vs prior 2026-03 and retains python.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log latest entry 2025-03-01 reports no properties added/updated/removed; its 2024-11 entry changes other unused fields. REST current 2026-07-15 adds runtime.name enum go vs 2026-03-15, retains python, and adds optional siteUpdateStrategy; neither affects used values.
